Notty: AI-Powered Note Taking App and Markdown Editor

Notty—an open-source note-taking app that seamlessly combines simplicity, artificial intelligence, and powerful markdown editing.

Notty is all about simplicity. Crafted with a minimalistic design, it provides an intuitive and clutter-free user experience, allowing you to focus on what matters most—your thoughts and ideas.

Github: https://github.com/Dhravya/notty
